shortBio.en: The Police guitarist; chorus/delay chord color instead of metal leads.
shortBio.zh: The Police 吉他手；用 chorus/延时和弦上色，而不是金属主音。

body.en: Older than Sting/Copeland; brings jazz/rock session vocabulary. Effects-heavy clean tones define Message in a Bottle and Every Breath You Take figures.
body.zh: 比 Sting/Copeland 年长；带来爵士/摇滚录音室语汇。效果器驱动的干净音色定义 Message in a Bottle 与 Every Breath You Take 的音型。
